indicators.note: in an across clue one piece placed on another follows it, so the bank word comes after

parts.note: far as in 'far better', meaning much better
a bank of switches or seats is a row of them

explanation.surface: A gambler stakes everything on a lot of rubbish lying about.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the litter here is a sow's brood of piglets, not rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: A farrow is the name for a whole brood of piglets born to one sow at a time.

parts.note: fare is the food served, as in pub fare
a well is a source of water or oil

explanation.surface: Something that has been eaten for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: So long is an informal parting phrase, a way of saying goodbye.

definitions.meaning: the 1976 boxing film starring Sylvester Stallone

explanation.definitionFit: Rocky means unsteady or tottering, and is also the title of Stallone's famous boxing film.

clue.text: Aboard a steamship is a shipping magnate

parts.note: on board a vessel is to be on it
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone on a steamer turns out to own a fleet of ships.
explanation.walkthrough: Aristotle Onassis was the Greek shipping tycoon, so the steamship surface is entirely in his world.
explanation.definitionFit: Aristotle Onassis was a famously rich Greek tanker owner, the archetypal shipping tycoon.

parts.note: to ban someone is to exclude them

indicators.note: most of a word means all but its final letter, so the last letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: a domestic animal is a tame one

explanation.surface: Keep out the greater part of the farmyard poultry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'domestic fowl' reads as one phrase, but 'domestic' feeds the wordplay and 'fowl' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A bantam is a small breed of chicken, a kind of domestic fowl.

clue.text: Move elsewhere on Jura, possibly letting daughter move in

indicators.note: a daughter moving in takes up residence inside the rearranged letters
possibly signals that the letters of the two words may be arranged another way

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written; a Scottish island
D is the usual abbreviation for daughter in family trees

explanation.surface: A family relocates to the Hebridean island of Jura and the daughter comes to live with them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Move elsewhere' sounds like relocating house, but it is a meeting moving on; 'possibly' scrambles the first two words to AJOURN, and 'move in' admits D.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjourn can mean to go off somewhere else, as when a party adjourns to the bar.

clue.text: Steaks done differently in city on the Loire

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit inside the name of the French city

parts.note: Tours is a city on the River Loire in France

indicators.note: done differently means its letters are put in another order

explanation.surface: Beef is cooked in an unusual way in a French town.
explanation.walkthrough: Tours is a French city on the Loire; 'differently' gives NEDO, and 'in' places it before the final S.
explanation.definitionFit: Tournedos are small round thick cuts of beef fillet, a French style of steak.

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts, a graduate

indicators.note: said signals that the word is spoken, giving a spelling that only sounds the same

parts.note: to take someone in is to trick or deceive them

explanation.surface: A student swallows what was said about the mould.
explanation.walkthrough: TRICKS, meaning 'takes in', when spoken gives TRIX.
explanation.definitionFit: A matrix is a mould in which something such as type or a coin is cast or shaped.

clue.text: Make a public announcement in favour of application

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a claim is an application, as in an insurance claim

explanation.surface: Announce publicly that you support someone's request.
explanation.definitionFit: To proclaim is to declare something openly to everyone.

clue.text: Arm of the Irish Sea — a master in it, adrift

indicators.note: a ship adrift is out of place, so the letters are scattered into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A ship's captain finds himself drifting in a channel of the Irish Sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adrift' rearranges A MASTER IN into MENAISTRA. The Menai Strait separates Anglesey from mainland Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: The Menai Strait is the channel of water between Anglesey and north Wales, part of the Irish Sea.

parts.note: an aunty is a relative

explanation.surface: A judge's relation turns out to be lively.
explanation.definitionFit: Jaunty means lively and cheerful in manner, much like sprightly.

clue.text: Influence wife in the course of speech

indicators.note: the wife's letter comes in the middle of the speech word

parts.note: to have one's say is to have a turn at speaking

explanation.surface: A woman holds sway over her husband during a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Sway is power or control over others, the same as influence.

clue.text: An inquest performed close to Brixton Prison

indicators.note: performed signals the letters are worked into a new shape

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: close to a word means its final letter

explanation.surface: A coroner's hearing is held near a London jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brixton Prison' reads as one jail, but only the final letter of Brixton is used. San Quentin is a prison in California; Brixton is a prison in south London.
explanation.definitionFit: San Quentin is a famous state prison in California.

definitions.meaning: as in an ... look, one of disapproval
a whiskey cocktail with bitters, sugar and orange

explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned look is a disapproving one, and the Old Fashioned is a classic American whiskey cocktail.

clue.text: Female is hard on night-watchman in Welsh port

parts.note: taken as written
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
a night-watchman is a guard

explanation.surface: A woman is tough on the man keeping watch in a harbour town in Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: Fishguard is a ferry port in Pembrokeshire, south-west Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Fishguard is a ferry port on the Pembrokeshire coast of Wales.

definitions.meaning: to show plainly, as a verb
the document listing everyone on board a flight

explanation.definitionFit: To manifest is to display openly, and a manifest is the list of passengers or cargo carried on a flight.

definitions.meaning: a bright meteor streaking across the night sky
the Wild West sharpshooter was a star of shooting, playfully read

explanation.definitionFit: A meteor seen burning in the sky is a shooting star, and Annie Oakley was a star at shooting.

clue.text: In which one may pick apples or variety of beet?

definitions.text: In which one may pick apples

parts.note: chard, or Swiss chard, is a leaf beet

parts.note: a nut is an enthusiast, as in a fitness nut
a case is a trial in court

explanation.surface: A deranged admirer stands trial.

clue.text: Casual walk in street with wind behind

parts.note: to wind something up is to roll it

clue.text: What the successful dramatist has put on vessel

a craft is a boat or vessel

explanation.surface: A playwright's hit has been mounted aboard a ship.

indicators.note: horrid suggests the letters are mangled into another order

parts.note: which and that are both relative pronouns

clue.text: Song from Zaire associated with many a fanatic

parts.note: an air is a song or tune
